stories.title: Hegseth boasts of Maduro’s capture while vowing to deepen US military cooperation with Venezuela
stories.summary: The US defense secretary called the former president’s capture the ‘most sophisticated military operation’ in Latin American history Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”. Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999. stories.title: Shabana Mahmood backs ban on police marching in pride events in uniform
stories.summary: Home secretary says ‘routine two-tier policing’ does not exist, but public trust in impartial law enforcement must be restored Shabana Mahmood has backed a ban on police officers marching in pride events in uniform as she said there had been a “few examples” of two-tier policing . Although she said there was no systematic or routine two-tier policing, the home secretary said “a new impartiality standard” was necessary to reverse the fall in the public’s faith in law enforcement. stories.title: US admits ‘substantial’ change to extradition request translation for leftist activist
stories.summary: DoJ cites three examples of alterations from English into Spanish for James ‘Fergie’ Chambers after Guardian report US authorities have admitted altering the translation of an extradition request for James “Fergie” Chambers from English into Spanish, attributing violent and illegal actions to the wealthy activist and philanthropist that were not in the original. Chambers’s case is the first known instance of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas, an accusation apparently tied to an international money-laundering charge in the criminal complaint underpinning the extradition request and donations to organizations helping Palestinians in Gaza. Continue reading...
